title: RELEASING.md publish layer table misses publishable crates
description: RELEASING.md 'Layer table' lists no layer for jmap-chat-mimi-types, jmap-chat-mimi-server, jmap-chat-federation-types, jmap-chat-federation-server, jmap-peer-auth, jmap-peer-auth-io, jmap-did-resolver, jmap-web-push or the chat-*-server binding crates, all publishable (no publish = false). A release following the table would skip them or publish out of dependency order. Found while adding jmap-chat-mimi-server (JMAP-6k5d.2). Fix: add each to the layer of its deepest dependency.
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (already_fixed, skeptic-confirmed): cc87669d 'docs(releasing): list all 57 crates by layer'. RELEASING.md:42-45 lists every crate named in the bead (mimi, federation, peer-auth(-io), did-resolver, web-push, chat-*-server). A scripted check of every crate without publish=false against the layer table found none missing. | check: I checked all 58 workspace packages from cargo metadata: every one without publish=false appears in the RELEASING.md layer table, so none is missing.
